events.title: Robert the Bruce crowned King of Scots at Scone
events.description: Weeks after killing his rival John Comyn, Bruce was crowned in defiance of Edward I. Defeated and hunted that year, he fought back to win at Bannockburn in 1314.
events.html: Weeks after killing his rival John Comyn, Bruce was crowned in defiance of Edward I. Defeated and hunted that year, he fought back to win at Bannockburn in 1314.

events.title: Christiaan Huygens discovers Titan
events.description: Using a telescope he had built with his brother, Huygens found Saturn's largest moon. Titan is now known to have a thick atmosphere and lakes of liquid methane.
events.html: Using a telescope he had built with his brother, Huygens found Saturn's largest moon. Titan is now known to have a thick atmosphere and lakes of liquid methane.

events.title: Britain abolishes the slave trade
events.description: The Slave Trade Act received royal assent, banning British participation in the Atlantic slave trade. Slavery itself continued in British colonies until the Abolition Act of 1833.
events.html: The Slave Trade Act received royal assent, banning British participation in the Atlantic slave trade. Slavery itself continued in British colonies until the Abolition Act of 1833.

events.title: Traditional start of the Greek War of Independence
events.description: Tradition holds that Bishop Germanos of Patras raised the banner of revolt on this day. After years of war and great-power intervention, Greece became independent in 1830.
events.html: Tradition holds that Bishop Germanos of Patras raised the banner of revolt on this day. After years of war and great-power intervention, Greece became independent in 1830.

events.title: Triangle Shirtwaist Factory fire kills 146 in New York
events.description: Fire swept through a garment factory near Washington Square, and locked doors trapped workers, mostly young immigrant women. The disaster led to new fire safety and labour laws.
events.html: Fire swept through a garment factory near Washington Square, and locked doors trapped workers, mostly young immigrant women. The disaster led to new fire safety and labour laws.

events.title: Treaty of Rome signed
events.description: France, West Germany, Italy, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg signed treaties creating the European Economic Community and Euratom. The EEC grew into today's European Union.
events.html: France, West Germany, Italy, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg signed treaties creating the European Economic Community and Euratom. The EEC grew into today's European Union.
